title: Ensure linear history is required
description: A linear history keeps the record of what shipped simple to read and to bisect. Merge commits let a branch's history be reshaped in ways that are hard to audit after the fact.
remediation: Repository settings -> Pull requests -> Merge strategies: disable "Merge commit" (no-ff) and "Rebase, merge commit" (rebase-no-ff), leaving fast-forward, rebase-fast-forward or squash strategies enabled. Set the same at Project settings -> Pull requests to apply project-wide. If your workflow requires merge commits, add the strategy ID to nonLinearMergeStrategies in scm-bench's config to adjust what counts.
fixSummary: Disable "Merge commit" at Repository settings -> Pull requests -> Merge strategies.
